<span data-as="p"><strong>Product Visuals</strong>:</span>

<li>Product mockups and prototypes</li>
<li>Feature illustrations</li>
<li>UI/UX concepts</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Marketing Assets</strong>:</span>
<ul>
<li>Social media graphics</li>
<li>Blog post illustrations</li>
<li>Ad creatives</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Presentations</strong>:</span>
<ul>
<li>Custom slide backgrounds</li>
<li>Concept illustrations</li>
<li>Visual metaphors</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Diagrams &amp; Charts</strong>:</span>

<li>Process flows</li>
<li>System architectures</li>
<li>Infographics</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="tips-for-better-images"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#tips-for-better-images">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Tips for Better Images</span></h3>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Be specific about style</strong>:</span>
<ul>
<li>✅ “Minimalist, modern, professional photography”</li>
<li>✅ “Flat design illustration, bright colors”</li>
<li>❌ “Make it look good”</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Describe composition</strong>:</span>
<ul>
<li>✅ “Centered subject, blurred background, natural lighting”</li>
<li>❌ “A picture of…”</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Specify use case</strong>:</span>
<ul>
<li>✅ “For Instagram post, square format, bold text overlay”</li>
<li>✅ “For presentation slide, wide format, subtle background”</li>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="common-questions"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#common-questions">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Common Questions</span></h2>
<span data-as="p"><strong>What image formats are supported?</strong> PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, and more. For generation, you can specify format.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>How long can videos be?</strong> Manus can process videos up to several hours long. Longer videos take more time.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>What audio formats work for transcription?</strong> MP3, WAV, M4A, WEBM, and most common audio formats.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Can I generate images in specific sizes?</strong> Yes. Specify dimensions: “Generate a 1920x1080 image…” or “Square format for Instagram…”</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>How accurate is speech transcription?</strong> Very high accuracy, even with accents, multiple speakers, or background noise.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Can I generate videos?</strong> Yes. Manus can generate short video clips and animations.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Are there limits on generation?</strong> Generation uses credits. Check your plan for limits.</span>
<hr/>
